marketing.targetReader: Scholarship foundation staff reviewing payroll and outreach costs during a registered fundraiser
marketing.readerQuestion: How much of the donations received may cover salaries and advertising?
ctaOutcomes: Expense ceiling based on actual receipts
Whether an amendment or approval for another use should be considered

approvedBy: Comparison draft — user approval required; do not publish

cards.oneMessage: Check both the statutory ceiling based on actual receipts and the purpose of each expense.

sourceTrace.heading: 에토스 장학재단의 첫 번째 고민, 장학금만 지급하면 사업이 끝날까요?

cards.headline: Can donations cover salaries and ads?
body: Suppose Ethos Scholarship Foundation raised KRW 80m.
cards.takeaway: Start with donations actually received and the purpose of each expense.
cards.design: Make 15% the hero figure, next to the KRW 1bn-or-less condition; place an expense approval sheet and receipts behind it.

cards.oneMessage: The expense ceiling is calculated from donations actually received, not the registered target.

sourceTrace.heading: 등록목표액 1억 원인데, 왜 모집비용은 1,200만 원까지만 계산할까요?

cards.headline: Does a KRW 100m target set the cost limit?

body.text: The foundation registered a KRW 100m target, but this target does not determine the statutory expense ceiling.
It actually raised KRW 80m; amounts up to KRW 1bn are subject to a cost ratio of no more than 15%.

cards.takeaway: Calculate the ceiling from KRW 80m received, not the KRW 100m target.
cards.design: Put the registration certificate (KRW 100m target) beside the donation ledger (KRW 80m received); highlight the actual receipts.

cards.oneMessage: If every planned cost is covered by the statutory expense rule, the plan exceeds the current calculated ceiling by KRW 2m.

sourceTrace.heading: 등록목표액 1억 원인데, 왜 모집비용은 1,200만 원까지만 계산할까요?

cards.headline: KRW 14m planned against a KRW 12m ceiling

body.text: Only if all costs fall under Article 13.

cards.takeaway: KRW 2m over only if all costs are Article 13 expenses paid from this registered fundraiser.
cards.design: Three proportional bars for KRW 14m, KRW 12m and KRW 2m; label the difference as conditional and the costs as planned, not already spent.

cards.oneMessage: Match payroll with the employee's actual duties and the funding source.

sourceTrace.heading: 직원 급여 800만 원, 어떤 업무에 대한 비용일까요?

cards.headline: What did the KRW 8m employee do?

body.text: Did they send donor notices and log contributions?
Did they process applications and prepare review files?
Match job duties with payroll, transfers and funding records.

cards.takeaway: Scholarship selection work does not automatically fall outside Article 13.
cards.design: Show one employee between a donor ledger and scholarship applications; connect the person to duty records and payroll documents.

cards.oneMessage: Review what the outreach actually promoted and match it with payment evidence.

sourceTrace.heading: 광고비 300만 원과 인쇄비 100만 원은 어떤 홍보를 위한 돈이었을까요?

cards.headline: What did the ads actually promote?

body.text: Match the donor appeal with the published ad and contract.
Was it an applicant notice on eligibility and deadlines?
Compare the brochures with the print order and payments.

cards.takeaway: A notice to scholarship applicants is not automatically exempt from Article 13.
cards.design: Split the canvas between a donor appeal and a scholarship application notice; place the actual brochure and invoice along the bottom.

cards.oneMessage: A ledger label does not replace evidence of the work, funding source and payment.

sourceTrace.heading: 장학금 지급액 6,000만 원은 사용명세서에 어떻게 적을까요?

cards.headline: Relabeling a ledger does not change money spent.
body: Check the work done, funding source and payment records.
cards.design: Use one oversized conclusion line; show a renamed ledger entry behind unchanged payroll and transfer records, with ample breathing room.

cards.oneMessage: Scholarship payments and payroll require different records and separate legal checks.

sourceTrace.heading: 장학금 지급액 6,000만 원은 사용명세서에 어떻게 적을까요?

cards.headline: Scholarships and payroll need different proof

body.text: For 30 students at KRW 2m each (KRW 60m planned), compare selection decisions with actual payment records.
For KRW 8m in planned pay, check duties, the source of funds and whether Article 13 applies.

cards.takeaway: A 'program expense' label alone does not exempt payroll from Article 13.
cards.design: Use two document stacks: student selection and transfers on one side, job assignments and payroll on the other; separate accounting labels from legal treatment.

cards.oneMessage: Using leftover donations for a similar purpose requires a statutory ground and approval from the registration authority.

sourceTrace.heading: 장학금을 지급하고 남은 후원금, 다른 공익사업에 사용해도 될까요?

cards.headline: Can leftover donations fund a new project?

body.text: Use donations for the registered fundraising purpose.
The purpose cannot be met, or funds remain after it is met.
Follow the decree and obtain authority approval to use funds for a similar purpose.

cards.takeaway: A broad charter alone does not authorize another use.
cards.design: Show the registered scholarship purpose and proposed youth education program on separate documents, with an approval checkpoint between them.

cards.oneMessage: The judgment classified member payments; it did not authorize unlimited salaries or advertising costs.

sourceTrace.heading: 실제 판례에서도 인건비와 홍보비가 문제 됐습니다

cards.headline: Are member dues regulated as donations?
body: The Court examined members' rights, duties and operations, then held their payments were not donations regulated by the Act.
It did not permit unlimited salaries or ads; a foundation cannot copy that membership finding.
cards.takeaway: Identify the legal nature of each receipt.
cards.design: Place a judgment file next to a magnifying glass over member dues and donations; make it clear this is a paraphrase, not a direct quotation.

cards.oneMessage: Gather the records before payment and identify the ceiling, funding source and procedures that need review.

sourceTrace.heading: 에토스 장학재단의 지출 결재, 무엇부터 확인해야 할까요?

cards.headline: Before approving costs, check these records

body.text: Gather the registration, use plan, donation and expense records, payroll duties and ad evidence.
Check the cap, cost purpose, funding source and needed approvals; drafting and filing are separate paid work.

cards.takeaway: Ethos Administrative Attorney Office offers a free initial review.
cards.design: Left: the documents the foundation can gather. Right: what the preliminary review examines. Reserve one restrained line for the free review and keep paid drafting and filing distinct.
